text:
alex_doe: Hi team — signed up a few minutes ago, verified email, but I don't see any free-trial credits on the account. account id: acct_01G7A2, region: europe-west. No payment method added.

maria_support: Hey @alex_doe, sorry about that. Quick Qs: did you complete the email link click? and can you confirm the exact email you used? :slightly_smiling_face:

alex_doe: Yup clicked the link right away. email: alex+trial@startup.com. got the welcome email.

billing_bot: Automated check: trial_grant_status=FAILED code=GATE_PAYMENT_METHOD_MISSING message="Payment method required for trial in this region"

maria_support: billing bot shows a gate for missing payment method. That's unexpected — our free trials usually don't require a card in EU. escalating to payments. @payments_jun can you take a look?

payments_jun: on it. can you paste the full response from the trial service/log or the request id?

maria_support: Request id from client payload: req_5b9f2c. Here's the trial service log snapshot I pulled:```2026-03-15T14:22:10Z INFO grant_trial user=acct_01G7A2 req=req_5b9f2c outcome=DENIED reason=region_policy_mismatch gate=payment_method_required```

payments_jun: thanks. running a quick DB check for user flags.```SELECT id, email, country, payment_methods, trial_flags FROM users WHERE id='acct_01G7A2'; -- result: id=acct_01G7A2, email=alex+trial@startup.com, country=NULL, payment_methods=[], trial_flags=[]```

payments_jun: country is NULL which triggers a safety path that requires a payment method for new trials (we added this last quarter to reduce fraud in unknown-country signups). That explains the gate.

alex_doe: oh, I didn't set a country anywhere in signup. Is there a way to retroactively get the credits without adding a card?

maria_support: Two options: 1) add a payment method (works instantly) or 2) we can set country="GB" on the backend and re-run the grant, but that requires an internal support escalation and manual approval. Which do you prefer?

alex_doe: I'd prefer no card if possible. I can confirm I'm in the UK.

maria_support: Ok I'll do the manual route. @eng-oncall tagging for a quick config change to allow grant after identity confirmation.

eng-oncall: Looking. We have a manual override flow but need manager approval for >3 manual grants/day. Low volume today. Please provide the user's email and original signup timestamp so I can attach audit.

maria_support: Email alex+trial@startup.com, signup_ts=1759872300. Adding note: "Support: confirmed user email verified; user claims UK residency; no payment method; request manual country set to GB and retry trial grant."

eng-oncall: Done. I set country=GB and retriggered the grant job. Trial service response:```2026-03-15T14:40:03Z INFO grant_trial user=acct_01G7A2 req=req_5b9f2c outcome=GRANTED credits=2000 expires=2026-04-14T00:00:00Z```

billing_bot: Automated notification: trial_credits_assigned user=acct_01G7A2 amount=2000 unit=tokens

alex_doe: Woo! I see the credits now. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria_support: Glad it's resolved. We'll follow up with product/payments about the NULL-country path to reduce manual ops. Filing internal ticket.

sre_bot: Note: audit event created for manual country update by eng-oncall, reason="support manual override" request=req_5b9f2c

alex_doe: Appreciate the quick help. Closing from my side.

maria_support: Marking thread resolved. If anything else comes up ping support. :thumbsup:
